task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires only the conditional If blocker_moved then has_door_key at some point and an unconditional pick up of the target box. The hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and the hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) are not stated by the task. The task does not command an order between has_door_key and target_picked_up and does not require target_picked_up to follow blocker_moved; the box pickup is an unconditional hard goal. Remove the added Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and the added Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up). Keep the hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) and the hard Existence(target_picked_up). The RespondedExistence is the stated conditional; the extra ordering clauses are added requirements.

texts: If the blocker is moved, the door key must also be acquired at some point
